basis: Name indicates cardiac abnormalities and limb shortening; no definition or phenotypes establish additional organ involvement.
Congenital cardiac malposition; other organ malformations are occasional. Situs reversal alone does not establish organ damage.
Sudden loss of inner-ear or auditory function; possible infectious or vascular causes do not define the whole group.
Carcinoma in situ originates in bile duct epithelium; both intrahepatic and extrahepatic ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
Defining malformations affect the diaphragm, bowel and spleen. Associated pulmonary injury is not established as common.
Urethral disease belongs to the urinary axis; infection is not shared across the umbrella.
Localized loss of subcutaneous fat; systemic metabolic dysfunction is not intrinsic to localized lipodystrophy.
Congenital hand and foot deformities with frequent joint contractures and brachydactyly; high palate alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Cataract affects the cortex of the ocular lens.
Clonal marrow disorder with ineffective erythropoiesis and anemia; hepatic findings are occasional and cardiac failure very rare.
Disease is confined to breast tissue, outside the axes; unknown etiology does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism.
Heme synthesis disorder characterized by neonatal hemolytic anemia; damaging photosensitivity frequency is uncertain; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.
Biotin-dependent metabolic defect; seizures, perioral eczema and keratoconjunctivitis each occur in 80-99%. Tachypnea reflects acidosis, not intrinsic lung disease.
Inherited retinal cone dysfunction causing selective loss of blue color vision.
Cowden mucocutaneous hamartomas; GI polyps and benign thyroid lesions each affect >30% in Cowden disease; subtype-specific frequencies are limited.
Primary pulmonary adenocarcinoma growing along alveolar walls.
Benign tumor of a reproductive vestibular gland; Bartholin gland tissue is outside the thirteen axes.
Beta-ketothiolase deficiency disrupts isoleucine and ketone metabolism; permanent neurologic injury affects a minority.
Phospholipid synthesis disorder with spastic paraplegia; retinal abnormalities occur in 100%, reduced vision in 30-79%; cleft palate in 30-79%.
Neoplasm occupies cauda equina nerve roots; urinary or motor symptoms do not establish separate organ damage across this umbrella.
Defined by sensorineural deafness and atopic dermatitis; dermatitis supplies the immune-mediated mechanism axis.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder defined by auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy, both documented in 8/8 patients.
Neurodevelopmental disorder impairing acquisition or processing of specific information.
Gestational trophoblastic neoplasm invading uterine myometrium; reproductive and obstetric tissues have no axis.
Hereditary motor neuronopathy; persistent thenar atrophy and pes cavus in 4/4, peroneal atrophy in 3/4 support musculoskeletal involvement.
